Package dev.turboism.sdk.ui

Record Class UserFileRequest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.turboism.sdk.ui.UserFileRequest
Record Components:
id - non-blank, bounded plugin request identity
title - non-blank, bounded user-facing chooser title
allowedExtensions - immutable extension filters without dots or path syntax
mode - requested read or write authorization
lifetime - requested lifetime for the resulting grant

Throws: NullPointerException if a component is null

Throws: IllegalArgumentException if text or an extension is invalid

public record UserFileRequest(String id, String title, List<String> allowedExtensions, UserFileMode mode, UserFileLifetime lifetime) extends Record
Declarative request for an opaque, user-selected file grant.

The request describes a requested mode and lifetime, not a path. Extension filters are defensively copied and accept simple extension tokens only; an empty list allows every extension. A granted request still yields an opaque UserFileHandle, never a path.
